answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: make reputation non-transferable and time-vested. Weight accrues only from sustained, verified work across real elapsed epochs, and it cannot be bought, sold, or moved between accounts. A brand-new identity is a blank crystal with zero standing, however much capital backs it. To field a thousand influential fakes, an attacker must run all thousand doing genuine graded work over many epochs, aging each separately. There is no sable shortcut and no ivory tower of purchased status: the only currency is time plus honest effort, which cannot be parallelized away.
